subject: Clearline MAP: token model + batching/caching checkpoints
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hsu <claire@clearline.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clearline MAP: token model + batching/caching checkpoints

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Before we lock the MAP milestones, we need to validate a few unit-econ assumptions so our committed pricing and provisioning plan is realistic for go-live. Can you confirm the items below by EOD Friday? I attached a working workbook (clearline_map_token_model_v1.xlsx) so you can drop numbers in directly.

Key asks (short):
- Expected daily active users and peak QPS (weekday peak window)
- Typical prompt + response token distribution (median, 75p, 95p) — or a short sample export
- Percent of calls where you expect to use streaming vs single-shot responses
- Percent of requests that can hit a prefix/KV cache (estimate)
- Any hard latency SLO (p50/p95) we should assume for your product routes

Why this matters: our MAP commitment will include sizing and a preferred batching/cache profile. Small shifts in avg tokens or cache hit rate change the GPU footprint and unit cost materially, so we want alignment up front to avoid rework mid-pilot.

If it's easier, we can take these in a quick 30-min call — tell me which day works.

Next steps from Redwood after we get numbers: we’ll produce a 2-page econ summary (tokens/$ table), an ops runbook for prefetch/batching, and a MAP milestone timeline that ties to procurement/PO dates.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- clearline_map_token_model_v1.xlsx (Excel workbook, model inputs)
- map-milestones-draft.pdf (initial milestone draft)
From: Claire Hsu <claire@clearline.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearline.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearline MAP: token model + batching/caching checkpoints

Hi Sofia —

Thanks — appreciate the clarity. I filled in the core fields in the workbook and included a short sample export. High-level answers:
- Baseline DAU (pilot): ~1,200; peak QPS during business hours ~75 sustained, short spikes to ~150 for 10–15m windows.
- Token distribution (approx): prompt median 80, 75p 120, 95p 300; response median 120, 75p 180, 95p 420.
- Streaming: ~10% of flows (long-running summaries); single-shot for the rest.
- Cacheable hits: we expect ~28% of requests to hit a prefix cache (many templated prompts).
- Latency SLO: p50 <200ms, p95 <700ms (app-facing requirement).

Procurement looped in for PO timing — they typically need 30 days from signed SOW to issue a PO. Let me know if you want a quick sync with them to discuss milestone billables.

Best,
Claire
Claire Hsu
Product Lead, Clearline Therapeutics
claire@clearline.com

Attachments referenced:
- clearline_sample_export_june16.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hsu <claire@clearline.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearline MAP: token model + batching/caching checkpoints

Claire / team —

Thanks for the quick numbers and the sample export — that helps a lot. A few clarifying questions and the assumptions we'll use in our sizing exercise unless you tell us otherwise:

Assumptions we plan to lock for the MAP econ summary:
- Avg tokens per request (prompt + response): 320 tokens (prompt 100 / response 220) — this is conservative vs your medians to allow headroom.
- Cache hit rate: 22% effective (we modeled both 22% and the 28% you provided; 22% is our conservative run to size reserved capacity).
- Batching behavior: target batching window 12–20ms for single-shot routes; effective batching utilization 40% during peak (we assume continuous batching when QPS > 30).
- Streaming overhead: modeled as +15% tokens and +25ms per-streaming-request latency impact.
- Peak sustained QPS for sizing: 100 requests/sec (blended).

Immediate questions:
1) Can you confirm percentage of requests that include retrieval/long-context that causes response >400 tokens? Your sample had ~8% >400, we want to know if that aligns with product expectations.
2) Are there any routes we should treat as priority with hard p95 <500ms? We can size a hot lane(s) but that changes cost.

If you’re comfortable with the assumptions above we'll produce: (A) a tokens-per-dollar matrix across three model quantization profiles, (B) a recommended reserved pool size with autoscale/burst policy, and (C) an ops checklist for cache warmups and prefetch rules. I'll attach an updated workbook after we align on question #1.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hsu <claire@clearline.com>, procurement@clearline.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearline MAP: token model + batching/caching checkpoints — consolidated assumptions & MAP milestones

Claire / Procurement team —

Per the thread and Karthik's notes, we've consolidated assumptions and produced the MAP milestones that tie to procurement dates. Summary below — consider this the econ checkpoint that will be appended to the MAP SOW. If you confirm, we'll proceed to update the HubSpot deal and route the draft SOW to DocuSign.

Consolidated econ assumptions (Redwood conservative run):
- Avg tokens per request (locked for MAP econ): 320 tokens
- Cache hit rate for sizing: 22% (we'll size to conservative, update after pilot telemetry)
- Peak blended QPS (sizing): 100 rps sustained, spikes to 150 for <15m
- Percent streaming: 10% (modeled as +15% token overhead)
- Batching target/impact: 12–20ms batching window; expected batching utilization 40% at peak; this produces ~18% tokens/$ improvement vs unbatched in our model

MAP milestones & procurement timing:
- Milestone 1 (Pilot start): feature flag enablement + telemetry capture — target 2027-07-11 — invoice on milestone
- Milestone 2 (Pilot completion): performance verification + econ sign-off — target 2027-08-08 — invoice on milestone
- Milestone 3 (GA prep): reserved pool sizing + SOW signoff — target 2027-09-01 — procurement lead time ~30 days post-SOW

Action items (owners):
- Claire: confirm % requests >400 tokens (answer needed by Thu 6/24) — Claire
- Procurement: confirm PO cadence and preferred billing milestones — procurement@clearline.com
- Karthik: finalize tokens/$ matrix and attach updated workbook (v2) — Karthik
- Sofia/Marissa: update HubSpot and route SOW for signature after econ confirmation — Sofia/Marissa

Links & artifacts:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/CL-2027-045
- Draft SOW/Map: https://www.docusign.com/link/CL-2027-045-MAP
- Attachments: clearline_map_token_model_v1.xlsx (filled), map-milestones-draft.pdf

If everyone is aligned, I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Friday to walk the tokens/$ table and signoff checklist.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai
